Digital clubbing is characterized by increased digital tip mass 
and increased longitudinal and transverse nail plate curvature 
(see Figure 34-4), and lung auscultation reveals crackles in the 
lungs. Chest radiograph may show hyperinflation, and a CT 
scan may show the classical picture of cystic bronchiectasis (see 
Figure 34-5). Pulmonary function testing shows airways 
obstruction. The spirogram shows reduced forced vital capacity 
(FVC), known as “restrictive pattern.” The reduced forced expi-
ratory volume (FEV1) and the reduced FEV1/FVC ratio are 
suggestive of airways obstruction. 
Early in life, the airways are colonized by bacteria.
